question: How do I configure my work email on a mobile device?
resolution: Navigate to Settings > Accounts > Add Account. Select Exchange/Office 365. Enter your corporate email and password. The server is outlook.office365.com. If prompted for domain, leave blank. Accept the security policy prompt. Sync mail, calendar, and contacts.

question: I cannot connect to the VPN from my home network. TLS handshake fails.
resolution: Ensure you have installed the latest VPN client from the internal software portal. The gateway address is vpn.corp.example.com. Use your SSO credentials, not a local password. If using macOS, grant the VPN profile in System Preferences > Profiles before connecting.

question: Where do I submit my direct deposit information for the first paycheck?
resolution: Log into the HRIS portal at hris.internal.example.com. Navigate to Pay > Direct Deposit. Enter routing number, account number, and account type. The first payroll cycle processes submissions made by the 5th of the month. You will receive a confirmation email within 2 business days.

question: When is the benefits enrollment window for new hires?
resolution: Benefits enrollment opens on your start date and closes 30 calendar days after. Log into the benefits portal at benefits.internal.example.com. You need your employee ID (on your offer letter) and date of birth to create your account. Coverage is retroactive to your start date.

question: My building access badge is not working on the parking gate.
resolution: Contact facilities at facilities@example.com with your badge ID (printed on the back). Temporary parking gate codes are issued within 4 hours. For after-hours issues, call the security desk at x5555. Permanent badge reprogramming requires a visit to the facilities office in Building A, Room 102.

question: What software licenses are available for new engineering hires?
resolution: Engineering new hires receive: JetBrains All Products Pack, GitHub Enterprise, AWS Dev account (request through service catalog), Docker Desktop, and 1Password Teams. Submit individual license requests through the IT service catalog at helpdesk.internal.example.com. Your manager must approve AWS and database tool licenses.

question: How do I file my relocation expense report?
resolution: Relocation expenses are handled through Concur under the 'Relocation' expense type. Attach scanned receipts as PDF. The relocation policy is at policy.internal.example.com/hr/relocation. Expenses over $500 require itemized receipts. Reimbursement is processed in the next pay period after approval. Contact relocation@example.com for questions.

question: How do I book a conference room for my onboarding buddy meeting?
resolution: Use the room booking system at rooms.internal.example.com. Filter by building and capacity. Rooms in Building B are generally quieter for 1:1 meetings. Bookings require calendar integration — accept the Outlook calendar invite to confirm. Rooms auto-release after 15 minutes if not checked in.

question: How do I join the relevant Slack channels for my department?
resolution: Default channels are added automatically: #general, #announcements, #it-helpdesk. Join department channels by searching in Slack: #eng-announce, #eng-standup, #design-critique, #product-updates. Social channels: #pets, #lunch-buddies, #running-club are optional. Use /open command to browse all public channels.

question: My two-factor authentication app stopped generating codes.
resolution: Open your authenticator app and check that the time is synced (Settings > Time correction for codes > Sync now). If codes still fail, visit sso.internal.example.com/recovery and use a backup code. Generate new backup codes immediately after recovery. Contact the IT security team at security@example.com if you are locked out.

question: How do I share my calendar with my manager and team?
resolution: In Outlook, right-click your calendar > Share > Add people. Enter email addresses and choose permission level: 'Can view all details' for managers, 'Can view when I'm busy' for team. Accept the sharing invitation that is sent. For Google Calendar users, share via calendar settings with your corporate Gmail account linked.

question: How do I get assigned an onboarding buddy or mentor?
resolution: Onboarding buddies are assigned automatically based on your department and role during your first week. If you have not been contacted by day 5, email onboarding@example.com. Mentors are assigned separately through the mentorship program portal at grow.internal.example.com — you can request a mentor after 30 days.
